description.value: Duncan Bay Store is a convenience and general store on the Island Highway in the Campbell River area, operated as part of The Wayne Procter Group's General Stores division. The group has nearly 35 years of history serving Vancouver Island communities with convenience retail across multiple locations from Nanaimo to Campbell River. Its roadside position on the Island Highway makes it a practical resupply point for cyclists traveling the coast.
